rule: Initially, an ordered pair of positive integers (n, k) is written on a sheet of paper. Two players take turns. In each turn, if the pair (a, b) is on the sheet and is not crossed out, then the player must cross it out and instead write (a, b + 1) or (a − b, b) on the sheet. The winner is the first player to write a pair in which at least one of the numbers is not positive.
step: Increase the second number by 1 or subtract it from the first.
